drafts.email1:
Hi Xudong,

I came across NCT07365280 — your Phase 2 study of Personalized Dendritic Cell Vaccine ZSNeo-DC1.1, Temozolomide (TMZ) in Glioblastoma, and wanted to reach out.

Phase 2 is where the exposure-response relationship becomes the central question — for Personalized Dendritic Cell Vaccine ZSNeo-DC1.1, Temozolomide (TMZ), the E-R for both efficacy and toxicity needs to be well-characterised before committing to a Phase 3 dose. Increasingly, FDA expects a rigorous E-R package before you even start the pivotal trial. With 78 patients, you'll have a dataset that supports a strong PopPK/PD model, and getting that analysis right now is often the difference between a clean Phase 3 dose rationale and a regulatory back-and-forth that delays the pivotal trial.

Our team at PumasAI — pharmacometricians and clinical pharmacologists, several from FDA, Pfizer, and BMS — has delivered 40+ regulatory submissions across FDA, EMA, PMDA, and Health Canada, all accepted on first review. We handle the full clinical pharmacology programme end-to-end: PopPK, exposure-response, dose optimisation, clinical trial simulation, and regulatory writing through submission.

Would a short call make sense to see if there's a fit? Happy to share a relevant case study from a similar Phase 2 Oncology programme beforehand.

I came across NCT07399132 — your EARLY/Phase 1 study of A Study of APL-10456-Vaccine, and wanted to reach out.

With 144 patients across the dose-escalation and expansion cohorts, there's a real opportunity to build a robust PopPK model early that directly informs RP2D selection — rather than retrofitting it later under time pressure.

Our team at PumasAI — pharmacometricians and clinical pharmacologists, several from FDA, Pfizer, and BMS — has delivered 40+ regulatory submissions across FDA, EMA, PMDA, and Health Canada, all accepted on first review. We handle the full clinical pharmacology programme end-to-end: NCA, PopPK, dose-escalation modelling, PK/PD characterisation, and regulatory writing through submission.

Would a short call make sense to see if there's a fit? Happy to share a relevant case study from a similar EARLY/Phase 1 Vaccines programme beforehand.
